# MrCalcs

> Free US calculators for work, pay and health. Each page has a calculator, the formula, worked examples, FAQs and links to official sources (DOL, IRS, SSA, CDC).

## Calculators
- [Work Hours Calculator](https://mrcalcs.com/work-hours-calculator.html): Daily and weekly hours with breaks, night shifts, overtime and pay.
- [Time Card Calculator](https://mrcalcs.com/time-card-calculator.html): Weekly timesheet with lunch breaks: total hours, overtime and pay.
- [Overtime Calculator](https://mrcalcs.com/overtime-calculator.html): Time-and-a-half and double-time pay, with federal and California daily rules.
- [Hours Between Times Calculator](https://mrcalcs.com/hours-between-times-calculator.html): How many hours is 8 to 5? Hours and minutes between any two times.
- [Lunch Break Calculator](https://mrcalcs.com/lunch-break-calculator.html): Find when lunch ends and your paid hours with a 30, 45 or 60 minute lunch.
- [California Overtime Calculator](https://mrcalcs.com/california-overtime-calculator.html): Daily overtime, double time and 7th-day pay under California law.
- [Hourly to Salary Calculator](https://mrcalcs.com/hourly-to-salary-calculator.html): Convert an hourly rate to yearly, monthly, biweekly and weekly pay.
- [Salary to Hourly Calculator](https://mrcalcs.com/salary-to-hourly-calculator.html): Convert a yearly, monthly or weekly salary to an hourly rate.
- [BMI Calculator](https://mrcalcs.com/bmi-calculator.html): BMI in feet, inches and pounds or cm and kg, with your healthy weight range.
- [Paycheck Calculator](https://mrcalcs.com/paycheck-calculator.html): Estimate take-home pay after federal tax, state tax, FICA and deductions.
